messages:
Maya: dropping a compact preview mock for tool-calls in run history — trying a 'signature pill' + one-line JSON snippet. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-v1 :eyes:
Kevin: nice direction. big asks: keyboard affordances and a clear sr-only summary. also avoid hover-only actions.
Lina: agree on SR text. propose aria-roledescription='tool call' and a concise accessible name: 'translate_document, preview, 3 fields'.
Priya: copy nit: header label — 'translate_document · 87ms' vs 'translate_document — 87ms' ? prefer middle dot for density.
Maya: going with middle dot. question about long names: ellipsize after ~28 chars and show full name in tooltip + sr-announcement on focus.
Kevin: interaction pattern: Tab lands on the card container, Enter toggles expansion of inline schema. when expanded, focus should move to the first field, Esc collapses and returns focus to the card.
Lina: screen reader flow: read 'Tool call, translate_document, collapsed, 3 fields.' When expanding say 'Expanded. Use arrow keys to navigate fields.' keep voice lines short.
Priya: small visual: add a micro badge :page_facing_up: when examples exist. instead of putting 'no params' text use 'no args provided' to be clearer to non-devs.
Maya: included a tiny JSON snippet in the mock:
```json
{"name":"translate_document","params":{"text":"Bonjour","target_lang":"en"}}
```
Kevin: layout thought: line1 signature pill + badges; line2 truncated first field; meta row small: type | size | latency. ensure header contrast to 4.5:1.
Lina: accessibility nit: 'Copy signature' should be keyboard reachable even if hidden visually on hover. use .sr-only focusable element that becomes visible on keyboard focus.
Priya: density debate: ops asks for compact 44px rows, design prefers 56px. can we try 48px with slightly larger type? test with keyboard outlines.
Maya: ok 48px test. also make focus-visible ring 3px at 2:1 contrast color — works at small sizes.
Kevin: microcopy decision: 'View full output' vs 'Expand schema' — prefer 'View full output' (action-focused). use aria-expanded toggles for the button.
Lina: also add role=list/listitem grouping so arrow navigation between cards is consistent.
preview-bot: Uploaded Figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-v1 (v2) — comments resolved.
Maya: thanks! I'll iterate and post new PNGs tomorrow. :party-parrot:
